name: Nitework

evidence.note: Band site calls itself Long Island's hottest dance band, playing top 40 and classic dance tunes since 2008.
Videos page features a promo video billing the group as a premier dance band for all occasions.
Black Pearl (Port Jefferson) listing describes a mix of dance, pop and party music.
Cooperage Inn Fall Festival band list shows Nitework on Saturday, Oct 3.

dancing.notes: Nitework sells itself as a dance band and plays upbeat pop and classic dance hits, so people usually dance freestyle in front of the band at bars and outdoor festivals.

description: Long Island cover band, active since 2008, that plays top 40 hits and classic dance songs at bars, beach spots, fall festivals and private parties.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Not the Scottish group Niteworks; matched by Long Island venues (Cooperage Inn, Black Pearl, Tiki Joe's). Rating based on band and venue text, not on watching crowd videos.

Directory research 2026-10-04: All current links confirmed from the band's own site. Booking phones published by the band: John Cipriani (646) 472-4296 (recorded) and Arnold Flor (516) 286-1979. No public email. The site lists upcoming shows at Ristegio's in Patchogue (Oct 16, Nov 7, Dec 12) that are not yet in our data. Images were downloaded at 1000 px (the image server upscales beyond the original size). Photo 1 has the band name printed across the top; focus is set lower to keep the people. Current description is accurate; not replaced.

Shows page lists Ristegio's Patchogue on Oct 16, Nov 7 and Dec 12, 2026, and 2026 past shows at Tiki Joe's, Black Pearl (Port Jefferson), The Oar (Patchogue) and Oakdale Yacht Club.
Contact page gives two phone numbers for bookings (John Cipriani and Arnold Flor).
